narrator.instruct: Fast, dry, witty female narrator teasing a friend. Brisk, punchy delivery with no long pauses.

mia.instruct: Loud, fearless, overconfident young woman, fast and excited.

jess.instruct: Worried best friend, half laughing, half panicking.

nora.instruct: Deadpan, unimpressed older sister, flat and sarcastic.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Your Aries friend quit her job at 7 a.m.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She decided in the shower and emailed from the towel.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: That's Mia. First, fastest, and loudest.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: By noon, she signed up for a marathon.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: By dinner, she opened a bakery.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: Mia, you have never baked anything!

lines.speaker: mia
lines.text: Then I'll learn on opening day!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And somehow, it works. The line wraps around the block.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then the oven door bursts open.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Black smoke fills the shop, and the alarm starts singing.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Her big sister walks in holding the manual.

lines.speaker: nora
lines.text: You were supposed to preheat it, not launch it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So what's going on inside an Aries head?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Picture a control room with one giant red button.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It says GO, and it's worn completely smooth.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Next to it is a dial labelled PATIENCE.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It's still in the plastic wrap.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The switch marked THINK FIRST was never plugged in.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The good news? Her anger burns out in four seconds.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The bakery closes on Tuesday, and she's not even sad.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: On Wednesday, Mia opens a kickboxing gym.

lines.speaker: mia
lines.text: How hard can punching be?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Her first student is already on the floor.
